checks.explanation: CalGEM oil permits surged roughly 300% in 2026 versus the prior three years combined after a new streamlined permitting law, a dramatic increase, but no source confirms actual oil production output has doubled (permits and production are not the same metric, and production lags permitting).

sources.title: California Oil Permits Surge 300% Under New Streamlined Law

checks.explanation: Confirmed: Trump-backed Steve Hilton advanced to the November 2026 general election as one of the top two finishers in California's June 2, 2026 gubernatorial primary.

sources.title: Republican Steve Hilton to face Democrat Xavier Becerra in California governor's race

checks.explanation: Confirmed: the top-two finishers were Steve Hilton and Xavier Becerra, one of the three Democrats Hilton specifically named as most likely; Tom Steyer and Katie Porter did not advance.

sources.title: Election results are in: Steve Hilton to face Becerra in November election

checks.explanation: Hilton has not yet been elected governor (the general election is in November 2026), so his policy plan hasn't been implemented or tested.
